tools.name: upload_exports
tools.description: Upload one or more Bing Webmaster Tools AI Performance CSV exports for a site. Pass each file's name and full text. Upload the overview export (the daily one) together with the grounding queries and pages exports so their dates are known, or give period_start and period_end (YYYY-MM-DD). Re-uploadin

tools.name: copilot_summary
tools.description: Overview for a site: total Copilot citations, busiest day, top 5 grounding queries and top 5 cited pages for the latest uploaded period (or the period ending period_end).

tools.name: cited_queries
tools.description: Grounding queries Copilot cited the site for, most citations first. Filter by text in the query, Bing's topic label or intent label.

tools.name: cited_pages
tools.description: The site's pages Copilot cited, most citations first. Filter by text in the URL.

tools.name: missed_queries
tools.description: Grounding queries where Copilot cited other sites and not this one, biggest first. Needs the opportunities export.

tools.name: what_changed
tools.description: What changed between the two latest uploaded periods: citations per day, new and gone grounding queries and pages, biggest gains and drops. Paid plan.

tools.name: page_queries
tools.description: Which grounding queries led Copilot to cite a given page. Needs a query-to-page mapping export (Bing's native exports don't include it).

tools.name: account_status
tools.description: This account's plan, sites and uploads.
